closeOut.title: B8b close-out c2s: the R28 run-twice gate in tests/unit/automation/step-specs.test.ts reads only literal it(...)/test(...) titles, so it misses B9's four render cases written as an it.each table and bun run check is red on the branch (run 37227263805). Make the scanner read what vitest runs

defects.what: testTitles() uses /\b(?:it|test)\(\s*(["'`])(.+?)\1/ and never sees `it.each([...])("$type runs twice without a second outside effect", ...)` at app/tests/unit/assets/steps.test.ts:323, whose four rows (render_cover, render_carousel, render_story, render_variants) all run and pass. Make the gate read the titles vitest actually runs: either expand .each templates (the $type placeholder over the table's `type:` literals in the same file) or, better, run vitest with the json reporter on the step test files and read the test names from its output. Do not duplicate B9's cases as literal titles and do not weaken the gate: a type with no run-twice case must still fail it (watched-fail: remove one row from B9's table in a scratch copy, the gate goes red). bun run check green on the branch is the proof.
defects.evidence: The second fix agent's report: `vitest -t "runs twice"` lists the four render types as passing; the regex in testTitles() matches literal titles only; CI run 37227263805 check job red on 'finds a run-twice test for every implemented type with an outside effect'.
